# Return keyboard focus after closing an entry form

## What & Why
After saving or cancelling an answer or opportunity dialog, keyboard users should return to the control that opened it instead of losing their place in the page.

## Done looks like
- Opening an answer form from the library returns focus to the same launch control after save or cancel.
- Opening an opportunity form from the queue returns focus to the same launch control after save or cancel.
- The behavior works for both page-level and empty-state add buttons.
